issues_in: Status inconsistency (checklist #3): `status_as_of_cutoff` is "partial live" but the last (and only) `history` entry records `status_as_of_cutoff: null` as of 2026-07-16. The 2026-... fixed: data.json: appended a 2026-08-11 per-field history change entry for status_as_of_cutoff (previous_value null [baseline 'no status' per NOTES.md] -> new_value 'partial live'), with reason citing Blockfusion/Blue 2025-11-19 PR and SEC investor presentation/script describing the Niagara Facility as energized/operating ~46-50 MW.

data.json: appended a 2026-08-11 per-field history change entry for capacity_mw (previous_value null -> new_value full structured object: 46/50 MW current, 100 MW planned Tier 3, 300 MW LOI, 85 MW take-or-pay, 500 MW interconnection queue), with reason.

data.json: appended a 2026-08-11 per-field history change entry for owner (previous_value null -> new_value 'North East Data LLC (Blockfusion USA, Inc. subsidiary)'), with reason citing Niagara County PROS parcel record and company/SEC disclosures.
data.json: kept the 2026-07-16 baseline snapshot entry (all nulls) unchanged so old values remain in history, per SKILL.md 'cover same key and preserve old value into history'.
NOTES.md: appended a dated bullet to the 2026-08-11 refresh section documenting the history sync (baseline snapshot preserved; per-field 2026-08-11 change entries added).
remaining_risks: The inventory issue string for this center is truncated mid-sentence in inventory.json; the fix targets the clearly stated core defect (history not reflecting the 2026-08-11 refresh). If the truncated tail intended an additional sub-item, it cannot be recovered from the inventory file.

No new source verification was performed for the 'partial live' status itself (out of scope for this history-sync issue); it rests on the existing NOTES.md 2026-08-11 evidence (PR + SEC disclosures + NYSRC DER report), consistent with the entry's contradictions.
SKILL.md was not modified; no schema drift issue was raised for this center.
summary: Fixed the status/history inconsistency for USDC-0126 by appending three per-field 2026-08-11 history change entries (status_as_of_cutoff null->partial live, capacity_mw null->structured capacity object, owner null->North East Data LLC) after the preserved 2026-07-16 baseline snapshot, matching the repo's dominant history convention, and documented the sync in NOTES.md. data.json validated as valid JSON (history now 4 entries).
